name: AWS FinOps MCP Server
description: Provides a comprehensive suite of 76 tools for AWS cloud resource optimization, cost management, and infrastructure monitoring. It enables users to identify unused resources, analyze cost trends, right-size capacity, and maintain security compliance through natural language.
